title: Align delegation worktree documentation and worker handoff with the Codex cleanup executor
outcome: Worker parents remain accountable for their worktree cleanup while docs and product handoff direct Codex to execute removal under the shared rule.
acceptance: docs/features/delegation-worktrees.md and src/delegation_worker_handoff.rs distinguish parent accountability from Codex directory/worktree execution and defer to the existing shared cleanup prerequisites and non-forced initial route.

The change adds no cleanup service, automated removal, executor switch, retry-after-denial or widened approval authority; required review/gate and exact authority-text coordination are carried without Markdown phrase-pinning tests.
